name: rfc9421_negative_v0
description: Negative (must-reject) conformance vectors for the A2A per-message signature extension v1, plus one positive control. Reproducible from the RFC 8032 section 7.1 keypair; run with verify.py.

cases.name: valid_control
cases.note: known-good; proves the runner is not vacuously failing everything

cases.name: wrong_keyid
cases.note: keyid not the expected one; must reject before resolving

cases.name: malformed_signature_input
cases.note: unparseable Signature-Input must fail closed, not raise

cases.name: replayed_nonce
cases.note: nonce already seen for this keyid

cases.name: missing_content_digest_coverage
cases.note: content-digest present but not a covered component
